shared_elements: carved stone surface in low relief
horizontal banded divisions of the field
weathered, cracked and eroded stone texture
justification: Both are eroded stone surfaces worked in shallow relief with a circular boss/disc and horizontal registers or bands crossing the field, which is about as far as the correspondence goes. A is a free-standing, roughly anthropomorphic block whose motifs are blurred, symmetrical and abstract, whereas B is a flat architectural wall panel with crisply cut, naturalistic profile figures, detailed hair and beard, a horse head and a rosette frieze — a completely different mode of representation and format.
